# Original OM-5 COLOR 1–3 back end: emulator runs

Native runs in om-emu: each profile supplies its own 12 saturation values; other modes unchanged.

**emulator; reported pass; partial report; not applicable.**

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5](../cameras/om5.md) · **Project:** [Caduceus port for the original OM-5 (tadejs)](../projects/caduceus-om5-tadejs.md)

**Firmware:** [om5 firmware 1.2, build 1200](../firmware/om5-1200.md) · **Mod build:** om5_color_core

**Provenance:** maintainer summary. **Reported:** 2026-11-08. **Test date:** Not explicitly recorded.

**Reported/observed package SHA-256:** not recorded.

## Procedure and coverage

Capture-path code entered natively in a booted om-emu E144 session with chosen property values; the port's verifier reports all checks passing.

- Profiles 1–3 read their own saturation values; profile 0 or above 3, and other modes, keep stock behaviour.
- Model check still passes on the rear screen and EVF with the patch applied.

Emulator: [https://github.com/flatpanda/om-emu](https://github.com/flatpanda/om-emu), revision `147ca89`, model `E144`.

Stand-ins: Capture-path code entered directly with chosen registers and property values, Image pipeline not emulated.

## Limits and assumptions

- om-emu does not emulate the image pipeline and never reaches this capture path in normal use; no photo was taken.
- Only saturation is per profile; contrast, sharpness and other profile values are not loaded.
- No Picture Mode entry, so the mode cannot be chosen on a camera. Not run on a camera.
- That the real firmware reaches this capture path for a normal still shot is the port's inference.
